objectives.en: I can use the zero conditional for facts and things that always happen.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת להשתמש בתנאי 0 לעובדות ולדברים שתמיד קורים.

objectives.en: I can use the first conditional (if + present, will) for real possibilities and their results.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת להשתמש בתנאי 1 (if + הווה, will) לאפשרויות אמיתיות ולתוצאות שלהן.

objectives.en: I can use unless, as soon as and when with the present to talk about the future.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת להשתמש ב-unless, ‏as soon as ו-when עם הווה כדי לדבר על העתיד.

warmup.en: Finish the sentence for yourself: If it rains this weekend, I ...
warmup.he: השלימו את המשפט על עצמכם: If it rains this weekend, I ... ושימו לב: בעברית אומרים 'אם יירד גשם' – בעתיד. באנגלית אחרי if בא דווקא הווה.

explanation.en: Compare: If you heat ice, it melts. (always true: a fact) / If it rains on Saturday, we'll stay at home. (one real possibility in the future, and its result)
explanation.he: השוו: If you heat ice, it melts – תמיד נכון, עובדה. ‏If it rains on Saturday, we'll stay at home – אפשרות אמיתית אחת בעתיד, והתוצאה שלה.

rows: facts, rules, things that always happen
If you press this button, the machine stops.
a real possibility in the future
If you hurry, you'll catch the bus.

explanation.en: No will after if, even when you talk about the future: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home (not *If it will rain). The if-part can come first (add a comma) or second (no comma): We'll stay at home if it rains.
explanation.he: אחרי if לא בא will, גם כשמדברים על העתיד: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home, ולא If it will rain. בעברית אומרים 'אם יירד גשם' בעתיד, אבל באנגלית אחרי if בא הווה פשוט. החלק של if יכול לבוא ראשון (עם פסיק) או שני (בלי פסיק): We'll stay at home if it rains.

rows: Unless you leave now, you'll miss the train. (= If you don't leave now...)
I'll text you as soon as I land.
something you are sure will happen
When I finish school, I'll travel. (I will finish.)
something that may or may not happen
If I get the job, I'll move to Haifa. (Maybe I won't get it.)

explanation.en: The same rule after unless, as soon as and when: present for the future. *as soon as I will arrive → as soon as I arrive. And unless already means 'if not': *Unless you don't hurry → Unless you hurry.
explanation.he: אותו כלל אחרי unless, ‏as soon as ו-when: הווה במשמעות עתיד. לא as soon as I will arrive אלא as soon as I arrive. ו-unless כבר אומר 'אם לא': לא Unless you don't hurry אלא Unless you hurry.

explanation.en: The result doesn't have to be will. It can be an imperative or a modal: If you're cold, close the window. If it's sunny, we might go to the beach. If you finish early, you can leave.
explanation.he: התוצאה לא חייבת להיות עם will. היא יכולה להיות ציווי או פועל מודאלי: If you're cold, close the window. ‏If it's sunny, we might go to the beach. ‏If you finish early, you can leave.

examples.en: If you heat water to 100 degrees, it boils.
examples.he: אם מחממים מים ל-100 מעלות, הם רותחים.

examples.en: If I drink coffee in the evening, I can't sleep.
examples.he: אם אני שותה קפה בערב, אני לא מצליח/ה להירדם.

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
examples.he: אם יירד מחר גשם, נישאר בבית.

examples.en: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
examples.he: אם לא תמהרו, תפספסו את האוטובוס.

examples.en: I won't go to the party unless Maya comes too.
examples.he: לא אלך למסיבה אלא אם כן גם מאיה תבוא.

examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I get to the airport.
examples.he: אתקשר אליך ברגע שאגיע לשדה התעופה.

examples.en: When I finish my army service, I'll travel to South America.
examples.he: כשאסיים את השירות הצבאי, אסע לדרום אמריקה.
examples.note: when = I'm sure it will happen

examples.en: What will you do if you don't get the job?
examples.he: מה תעשו אם לא תקבלו את העבודה?

examples.en: If you see Kenji, tell him I said hi.
examples.he: אם תראו את קנג'י, תגידו לו שאמרתי שלום.
examples.note: the result can be an imperative

vocab.example: You can't come in unless you have a ticket.
I'll message you as soon as I hear anything.
collocations: as soon as I get home

vocab.def: to use all of something so that there is none left

vocab.def: to be unable to move or to continue
vocab.example: If we leave at five, we'll get stuck in traffic.

vocab.def: (of a situation) to end in a good way
vocab.example: Don't worry. If you're patient, everything will work out.

vocab.def: to get red, painful skin from too much sun
vocab.example: If you don't wear sun cream, you'll get sunburnt.

vocab.def: to put electricity into a battery
vocab.example: If you don't charge your phone, it'll die before lunch.

vocab.def: the connection that lets a phone or radio work
vocab.example: I'll call you if I can get a signal.

vocab.def: to change from solid to liquid because of heat
vocab.example: If you leave chocolate in the sun, it melts.

vocab.def: (of a liquid) to get so hot that it bubbles
vocab.example: If you heat water to 100 degrees, it boils.

vocab.example: If you don't study, you'll fail the exam.

vocab.def: (British) to study again what you have learned, before an exam

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew the present-tense verb changes for gender and number, but there is nothing like the English -s for he, she and it. So the -s is easy to forget, especially in the if-part: If she misses the bus, she'll take a taxi (not *If she miss the bus).
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית פועל בהווה משתנה לפי מין ומספר, אבל אין בו משהו כמו ה-s האנגלית של he, she, it. לכן קל לשכוח אותה, במיוחד בחלק של if: If she misses the bus, she'll take a taxi, ולא If she miss the bus.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew a question can keep the order of a statement. In English will comes before the subject: What will you do if it rains? (not *What you will do if it rains?)
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית שאלה יכולה לשמור על סדר המילים של משפט רגיל ('מה תעשו אם יירד גשם?'). באנגלית will בא לפני הנושא: What will you do if it rains?, ולא What you will do if it rains?

prompt.en: Zero or first conditional? Sort the sentences.
prompt.he: תנאי 0 או תנאי 1? מיינו את המשפטים.

items.text: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
If I drink coffee at night, I can't sleep.
If you press this button, the light comes on.
If plants don't get water, they die.
If it's sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.
If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.
If Omer calls, I'll tell him.
If we win on Saturday, we'll be in the final.

hint.en: Look at the result: present simple or will?
hint.he: הסתכלו על התוצאה: הווה פשוט או will?

explanation.en: Zero = present + present for things that are always true. First = present + will for one possible situation in the future.
explanation.he: תנאי 0 = הווה + הווה לדברים שתמיד נכונים. תנאי 1 = הווה + will למצב אפשרי אחד בעתיד.

exercises.question: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll have the party inside.

0.en: No will after if, even about the future: If it rains tomorrow.
0.he: אחרי if לא בא will, גם כשמדברים על העתיד: If it rains tomorrow.

2.en: it takes -s in the present simple: it rains.
2.he: בהווה פשוט it מקבל s: it rains.

3.en: rained doesn't match we'll. For a real possibility in the future: If it rains, we'll...
3.he: rained לא מתאים ל-we'll. לאפשרות אמיתית בעתיד: If it rains, we'll...

explanation.en: First conditional: if + present simple, will + base verb: If it rains tomorrow, we'll have the party inside.
explanation.he: תנאי 1: if + הווה פשוט, ‏will + צורת הבסיס: If it rains tomorrow, we'll have the party inside.

prompt.en: Listen to Amir's voice message and answer the question.
prompt.he: הקשיבו להודעה הקולית של אמיר וענו על השאלה.

exercises.audio_text: Hi, it's Amir. The forecast says it might rain on Saturday. If it rains, we'll go bowling instead of going to the beach. I'll message you as soon as I know for sure.
exercises.question: What will Amir and his friends do if it rains?
options: They'll go to the beach anyway.

0.en: The beach is the plan if it doesn't rain. Listen for 'instead of going to the beach'.
0.he: הים הוא התוכנית אם לא יירד גשם. הקשיבו ל-instead of going to the beach.

1.en: He doesn't say they'll stay at home. They have a plan B.
1.he: הוא לא אומר שיישארו בבית. יש להם תוכנית ב'.

3.en: The plan is for Saturday. He'll message as soon as he knows for sure.
3.he: התוכנית היא לשבת. הוא ישלח הודעה ברגע שיֵדע בוודאות.

explanation.en: If it rains, we'll go bowling = the result of a real possibility. I'll message you as soon as I know = present (know) after as soon as.
explanation.he: If it rains, we'll go bowling = התוצאה של אפשרות אמיתית. ‏I'll message you as soon as I know = הווה (know) אחרי as soon as.

prompt.en: Choose the word that makes sense.

exercises.question: You won't pass the driving test ___ you practise more.

1.en: This says that practising more will make you fail – the opposite of the meaning.
1.he: זה אומר שתרגול נוסף יגרום לכם להיכשל – ההפך מהמשמעות.

2.en: With when, practising more would stop you passing. That doesn't make sense.
2.he: עם when, תרגול נוסף ימנע מכם לעבור. זה לא הגיוני.

3.en: With as soon as, you fail the moment you practise more. That doesn't make sense.
3.he: עם as soon as, תיכשלו ברגע שתתרגלו יותר. זה לא הגיוני.

explanation.en: unless = if ... not: You won't pass unless you practise more = If you don't practise more, you won't pass.
explanation.he: unless = אם לא: You won't pass unless you practise more = אם לא תתרגלו יותר, לא תעברו.

prompt.en: Maya knows she'll get her exam results next week. Choose the best word.
prompt.he: מאיה יודעת שהיא תקבל את תוצאות הבחינה בשבוע הבא. בחרו את המילה המתאימה ביותר.

exercises.question: ___ I get my results, I'll call you.

0.en: If suggests she isn't sure she'll get them. She knows she will, so When is better.
0.he: If רומז שהיא לא בטוחה שתקבל אותן. היא יודעת שתקבל, ולכן When מתאים יותר.

1.en: Unless = if not: 'If I don't get my results, I'll call you' doesn't make sense here.
1.he: Unless = אם לא: 'אם לא אקבל את התוצאות, אתקשר' לא הגיוני כאן.

explanation.en: when = something you're sure will happen; if = something that may or may not happen. Both are followed by the present: When I get...
explanation.he: when = משהו שבטוח יקרה; ‏if = משהו שאולי יקרה. אחרי שניהם בא הווה: When I get...

prompt.en: Complete with the present simple or will/won't and the verb in brackets.
prompt.he: השלימו בהווה פשוט או ב-will/won't עם הפועל שבסוגריים.

exercises.text: If you ___ (leave) now, you ___ (catch) the 8:15 train. But if you ___ (not hurry), you ___ (miss) it.
answers: leave
will catch
'll catch
don't hurry
will miss
'll miss

feedback.en: No will in the if-part: If you leave now.
feedback.he: בחלק של if אין will: If you leave now.

feedback.en: No will in the if-part, even in the negative: if you don't hurry.
feedback.he: בחלק של if אין will, גם בשלילה: if you don't hurry.

feedback.en: With you, use don't: if you don't hurry.
feedback.he: עם you משתמשים ב-don't: if you don't hurry.

feedback.en: The result of a possible future situation needs will: you'll catch.
feedback.he: תוצאה של מצב אפשרי בעתיד צריכה will: you'll catch.

feedback.en: The result needs will: you'll miss it.
feedback.he: התוצאה צריכה will: you'll miss it.

explanation.en: if-part: present simple (leave, don't hurry). Result: will + base verb (will catch, will miss).
explanation.he: החלק של if: הווה פשוט (leave, ‏don't hurry). התוצאה: will + צורת הבסיס (will catch, ‏will miss).

prompt.en: Read the group leader's email and answer the questions.
prompt.he: קראו את המייל של מדריך הקבוצה וענו על השאלות.

exercises.title: Desert hike this Friday – please read!
exercises.passage:
Hi everyone,

We're meeting at the main gate at 6:00 a.m. on Friday. The bus leaves at 6:15 sharp. If you arrive late, it will leave without you, so set two alarms!

The forecast says it will be very hot, even early in the morning. In the desert, if you don't drink enough, you get a headache and feel dizzy very quickly, so bring at least three litres of water. Nobody can join the hike unless they have proper walking shoes – no sandals, please.

The route is about 12 kilometres. If everything goes well, we'll reach the spring by 10:00 and have a long break there. You can swim if the water is deep enough, so pack a towel. If the heat gets too much, we'll take the shorter path back.

Phones don't usually work in the canyon, so don't panic if you can't get a signal. I'll send a message to your parents as soon as we're back on the bus.

If you have any questions, call me before Thursday evening.

See you on Friday!
Lior (group leader)

questions.statement: The bus will wait for people who arrive late.

explanation.en: 'If you arrive late, it will leave without you.'
explanation.he: בטקסט: If you arrive late, it will leave without you – האוטובוס ייסע בלעדיכם.

questions.question: What happens if someone comes in sandals?
options: They can take the shorter path.
They'll have to buy shoes at the gate.
They can't come on the hike.

0.en: The shorter path is for when the heat gets too much, not for sandals.
0.he: הדרך הקצרה מיועדת למקרה שיהיה חם מדי, לא לסנדלים.

1.en: The email doesn't mention buying shoes.
1.he: במייל אין שום דבר על קניית נעליים.

3.en: Lior will message the parents when the group is back on the bus, not because of sandals.
3.he: ליאור ישלח הודעה להורים כשהקבוצה תחזור לאוטובוס, לא בגלל סנדלים.

explanation.en: 'Nobody can join the hike unless they have proper walking shoes – no sandals.' unless = if ... not.
explanation.he: בטקסט: Nobody can join the hike unless they have proper walking shoes – no sandals. ‏unless = אם לא.

questions.question: 'In the desert, if you don't drink enough, you get a headache.' Why does Lior use the present simple in both parts?
options: It's a plan for Friday only.
It's a general fact: it always happens in the desert.

0.en: A plan for Friday would use will in the result. This is true every time, not only on Friday.
0.he: תוכנית ליום שישי הייתה עם will בתוצאה. זה נכון בכל פעם, לא רק ביום שישי.

2.en: It's real and it really happens. That's why it's a zero conditional.
2.he: זה אמיתי וזה באמת קורה. לכן זה תנאי 0.

explanation.en: Zero conditional (present + present) = a general fact: this always happens when you don't drink enough in the heat.
explanation.he: תנאי 0 (הווה + הווה) = עובדה כללית: זה תמיד קורה כשלא שותים מספיק בחום.

questions.text: If everything goes well, the group will reach the spring by ___.
answers: ten
10 am
10am
ten o'clock
10 o'clock

explanation.en: 'If everything goes well, we'll reach the spring by 10:00.'
explanation.he: בטקסט: If everything goes well, we'll reach the spring by 10:00.

questions.question: What will the group do if it gets too hot?
options: Go back on the shorter path.

1.en: They can swim if the water is deep enough. That's a different condition.
1.he: אפשר לשחות אם המים עמוקים מספיק. זה תנאי אחר.

2.en: Phones don't usually work in the canyon, and Lior will contact the parents later.
2.he: בקניון הטלפונים בדרך כלל לא עובדים, וליאור ייצור קשר עם ההורים מאוחר יותר.

explanation.en: 'If the heat gets too much, we'll take the shorter path back.'
explanation.he: בטקסט: If the heat gets too much, we'll take the shorter path back.

questions.statement: Lior will message the parents as soon as the group is back on the bus.

explanation.en: 'I'll send a message to your parents as soon as we're back on the bus.' Notice the present (we're) after as soon as.
explanation.he: בטקסט: I'll send a message to your parents as soon as we're back on the bus. שימו לב להווה (we're) אחרי as soon as.

prompt.en: Rewrite the sentence with unless. Keep the meaning.
prompt.he: כתבו את המשפט מחדש עם unless. שמרו על המשמעות.

exercises.source: If you don't book now, there won't be any seats left.
answers: Unless you book now, there won't be any seats left.
Unless you book now there won't be any seats left.
There won't be any seats left unless you book now.
Unless you book now, there will be no seats left.
There will be no seats left unless you book now.

wrong_feedback.match: Unless you don't book now, there won't be any seats left.

feedback.en: unless already means 'if not', so don't add don't: Unless you book now...
feedback.he: unless כבר אומר 'אם לא', ולכן לא מוסיפים don't: Unless you book now...

wrong_feedback.match: Unless you will book now, there won't be any seats left.

feedback.en: No will after unless: Unless you book now.
feedback.he: אחרי unless לא בא will: Unless you book now.

wrong_feedback.match: Unless you book now, there will be any seats left.

feedback.en: Keep the result negative: there won't be any seats left.
feedback.he: התוצאה נשארת בשלילה: there won't be any seats left.

hint.en: unless = if ... not. Which word do you remove?
hint.he: unless = אם לא. איזו מילה צריך להוריד?

explanation.en: If you don't book = Unless you book. The result stays the same: there won't be any seats left.
explanation.he: If you don't book = Unless you book. התוצאה נשארת כמו שהיא: there won't be any seats left.

prompt.en: Find the mistake and write the sentence correctly.
prompt.he: מצאו את הטעות וכתבו את המשפט נכון.

exercises.sentence: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
answers: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
If it rains tomorrow we will cancel the trip.
We will cancel the trip if it rains tomorrow.

explanation.en: will goes in the result, not in the if-part: If it rains tomorrow, we'll cancel the trip.
explanation.he: will בא בתוצאה, לא בחלק של if: If it rains tomorrow, we'll cancel the trip.

prompt.en: Find the mistake and write the sentence correctly.
prompt.he: מצאו את הטעות וכתבו את המשפט נכון.

exercises.sentence: I'll text you as soon as I will get home.
answers: I'll text you as soon as I get home.

hint.en: as soon as works like if.
hint.he: as soon as מתנהג כמו if.

explanation.en: After as soon as (and when, unless, if) use the present for the future: as soon as I get home.
explanation.he: אחרי as soon as (וגם when, ‏unless, ‏if) משתמשים בהווה במשמעות עתיד: as soon as I get home.

prompt.en: Find the mistake and write the sentence correctly.
prompt.he: מצאו את הטעות וכתבו את המשפט נכון.

exercises.sentence: If she miss the last bus, she'll take a taxi.
answers: If she misses the last bus, she'll take a taxi.
If she misses the last bus she'll take a taxi.
She'll take a taxi if she misses the last bus.

explanation.en: The if-part is in the present simple, so she needs -s (here -es): If she misses the last bus.
explanation.he: החלק של if בהווה פשוט, ולכן she צריכה s (כאן es): If she misses the last bus.

prompt.en: Put the words in order to make a question.

answers: If you don't get the job what will you do

explanation.en: Wh-word + will + subject + verb, then the if-part: What will you do if you don't get the job?
explanation.he: מילת שאלה + will + נושא + פועל, ואחר כך החלק של if: What will you do if you don't get the job?

answers: If it rains, we will stay at home.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If it rains we will stay at home.
If it rains we will stay home.
We will stay at home if it rains.
We will stay home if it rains.
If it rains, we will stay in.
We will stay in if it rains.
If it is raining, we will stay at home.
If it is raining, we will stay home.
We will stay at home if it is raining.
If it rains, we are going to stay at home.
If it rains, we are going to stay home.

wrong_feedback.match: If it will rain, we will stay at home.

feedback.en: In Hebrew both parts are in the future, but English uses the present after if: If it rains, we'll stay at home.
feedback.he: בעברית שני החלקים בעתיד ('יירד', 'נישאר'), אבל באנגלית אחרי if בא הווה: If it rains, we'll stay at home.

wrong_feedback.match: If it will rain, we will stay home.

feedback.en: In Hebrew both parts are in the future, but English uses the present after if: If it rains, we'll stay home.
feedback.he: בעברית שני החלקים בעתיד, אבל באנגלית אחרי if בא הווה: If it rains, we'll stay home.

wrong_feedback.match: If it rains, we stay at home.

feedback.en: This sounds like a general habit (zero conditional). For one possible situation in the future, use will: we'll stay at home.
feedback.he: זה נשמע כמו הרגל כללי (תנאי 0). למצב אפשרי אחד בעתיד משתמשים ב-will: we'll stay at home.

wrong_feedback.match: If it rains, we will stay in home.

feedback.en: English says stay at home (or stay home), not in home.
feedback.he: באנגלית אומרים stay at home (או stay home), לא in home.

wrong_feedback.match: If it rains, we will stay in the house.

feedback.en: Understandable, but the natural phrase is stay at home (or stay home, stay in).
feedback.he: מובן, אבל הצירוף הטבעי הוא stay at home (או stay home, ‏stay in).

hint.en: Which tense comes after if? And which in the result?
hint.he: איזה זמן בא אחרי if? ואיזה בתוצאה?

explanation.en: Hebrew: future + future. English: if + present, then will: If it rains, we'll stay at home.
explanation.he: בעברית: עתיד + עתיד. באנגלית: if + הווה, ואז will: If it rains, we'll stay at home.

exercises.audio_text: If the train is late again, I'll take a taxi to the airport.
answers: If the train is late again, I'll take a taxi to the airport.

hint.en: Listen for the short 'll in the second part.

explanation.en: if + present (is late), then will (I'll take). I'll is often hard to hear: /aɪl/.
explanation.he: if + הווה (is late), ואז will ‏(I'll take). קשה לשמוע את I'll: /aɪl/.

exercises.target: If it rains on Saturday, we'll go to the cinema instead.

focus.en: Short /ɪ/ in if and it; long /iː/ in we'll /wiːl/. Don't drop the 'll: without it, the sentence sounds like the present.
focus.he: תנועה קצרה /ɪ/ ב-if וב-it; תנועה ארוכה /iː/ ב-we'll ‏/wiːl/. אל תבליעו את ה-'ll: בלעדיו המשפט נשמע כמו הווה.

explanation.en: A natural first conditional for making plans: if + present, will in the result.
explanation.he: תנאי 1 טבעי לתכנון: if + הווה, ו-will בתוצאה.

prompt.en: Mediation: pass on a message in English.

task.en: Tom, a friend from London, is flying to Israel to stay with your family. Your mum sent you a message in Hebrew (you can see it in the Hebrew instructions). Tom doesn't read Hebrew. Write him a message in English (60-100 words) with all her information. Use if, as soon as, when or unless, with the present after them.
task.he: טום, חבר מלונדון, טס לארץ ויגור אצל המשפחה שלכם. אמא שלכם שלחה לכם את ההודעה הזאת: „תגידו לטום: אם הטיסה שלו נוחתת בזמן, אבא יאסוף אותו מהשדה. אם יש עיכוב, שייקח רכבת לתל אביב, ואנחנו נחכה לו בתחנה. שיתקשר אלינו ברגע שהוא נוחת. ואם יהיה חם בשבת, נלך לים – שלא ישכח בגד ים!” טום לא קורא עברית. כתבו לו הודעה באנגלית (60-100 מילים) עם כל המידע. השתמשו ב-if, ‏as soon as, ‏when או unless, ואחריהן בהווה.

exercises.model_answer: Hi Tom! My mum asked me to send you the plan. If your flight lands on time, my dad will pick you up at the airport. If it's late, take the train to Tel Aviv, and we'll wait for you at the station. Please call us as soon as you land, so we know where you are. And if it's hot on Saturday, we'll go to the beach, so don't forget your swimsuit! See you soon, Noa

checklist.en: I passed on all the information: the pick-up, the train if the flight is late, the phone call, the beach and the swimsuit.
checklist.he: העברתי את כל המידע: האיסוף מהשדה, הרכבת אם יש עיכוב, הטלפון, הים ובגד הים.

checklist.en: After if and as soon as I used the present: if your flight lands, as soon as you land.
checklist.he: אחרי if ו-as soon as השתמשתי בהווה: if your flight lands, ‏as soon as you land.

checklist.en: I used will (or an imperative) in the results: my dad will pick you up; take the train.
checklist.he: השתמשתי ב-will (או בציווי) בתוצאות: my dad will pick you up; ‏take the train.

checklist.en: I wrote naturally for Tom, not word for word from the Hebrew.
checklist.he: כתבתי בצורה טבעית לטום, ולא תרגום מילה במילה מהעברית.

key_points.en: Zero conditional = if + present, present: facts and things that always happen. If you heat ice, it melts.
key_points.he: תנאי 0 = if + הווה, הווה: עובדות ודברים שתמיד קורים. If you heat ice, it melts.

key_points.en: First conditional = if + present, will + base verb: a real possibility. If it rains, we'll stay at home.
key_points.he: תנאי 1 = if + הווה, ‏will + צורת הבסיס: אפשרות אמיתית. If it rains, we'll stay at home.

key_points.en: No will after if, unless, as soon as or when: as soon as I arrive (not *as soon as I will arrive).
key_points.he: אחרי if, ‏unless, ‏as soon as ו-when לא בא will: as soon as I arrive, ולא as soon as I will arrive.

key_points.en: unless = if ... not; when = I'm sure it will happen; if = maybe.
key_points.he: unless = אם לא; ‏when = בטוח שיקרה; ‏if = אולי.

key_points.en: Hebrew says 'if it will rain'; English says If it rains.
key_points.he: בעברית 'אם יירד גשם' (עתיד); באנגלית If it rains (הווה).
